name: privacyfold
description: 72 client-side WebAssembly, WebGPU, WebCrypto, and Canvas utilities that execute 100% locally with zero server uploads.

tools.name: privacyfold.ada_pdf
tools.title: ADA & WCAG PDF accessibility checker
tools.task: Audit document heading hierarchy, alt text & reading order for ADA compliance
tools.description: Check document structure against US ADA Title II/III, Section 508, and PDF/UA (ISO 14289) accessibility rules: document title, language tag, heading nesting, and image alt attributes.

tools.name: privacyfold.ai_airlock
tools.title: AI Airlock (PII redactor & token restorer)
tools.task: Sanitize personal data before prompting cloud AI, then restore locally
tools.description: Detect personal data (names, emails, SSN/NINO, IBAN, credit cards, phones, API keys) on your device, replace them with tokens ([PERSON_1], [EMAIL_1]) before pasting into ChatGPT/Claude, and restore real values locally afterwards.

tools.name: privacyfold.ai_writer
tools.title: Zero-download AI writer & rewriter (0 MB)
tools.task: Write essays, emails, scripts & fix grammar via browser built-in AI
tools.description: Uses your browser’s built-in local AI APIs (window.ai.languageModel, ai.rewriter, ai.summarizer — 0 MB download) with automatic fallback to SmolLM2-135M-Instruct (~45 MB) for grammar fixing, tone shifting, essays, cold emails, and video scripts.

tools.name: privacyfold.api_builder
tools.title: API request converter (cURL ↔ fetch ↔ axios)
tools.task: Convert cURL commands into JavaScript fetch() or Axios code locally
tools.description: Convert `curl` CLI requests (including headers, bearer tokens, and JSON bodies) into clean JavaScript `fetch()` or `axios` snippets without pasting private API keys into online converters.

tools.name: privacyfold.apostille_prep
tools.title: EU & Hague Apostille document prep
tools.task: Prepare a Hague Convention Apostille request & document authentication checklist
tools.description: Generate a Hague Convention (1961) Apostille certificate request sheet and cross-border document authentication checklist for birth, marriage, academic, or corporate filings.

tools.name: privacyfold.barcode_gen
tools.title: Barcode generator (Code 128, EAN-13, UPC-A)
tools.task: Generate clean SVG barcodes for inventory, retail & labels
tools.description: Generate crisp, vector SVG barcodes (Code 128, EAN-13, UPC-A) locally in your browser with zero tracking pixels.

tools.name: privacyfold.base64
tools.title: Base64 encoder and decoder
tools.task: Encode or decode Base64
tools.description: Convert text to Base64 and back. Handles any language and emoji.

tools.name: privacyfold.bg_remove
tools.title: AI background remover
tools.task: Remove image background on your GPU
tools.description: Isolate portraits, signatures, or products onto a transparent PNG or studio backdrop locally using BEN v2 / MODNet via ONNX Runtime WebGPU (~120ms per photo).

tools.name: privacyfold.chat_pdf
tools.title: Chat with PDF & document Q&A
tools.task: Query & summarize PDF documents using local vector embeddings
tools.description: Chunk document text in a Web Worker, compute local cosine-similarity embeddings (bge-micro ~22 MB + pdfjs-dist), and answer questions or summarize key points with 0 server uploads.

tools.name: privacyfold.clean_paste
tools.title: Link & text cleaner
tools.task: Remove tracking links and hidden characters
tools.description: Paste text or links to remove tracking parameters (such as utm, fbclid and gclid), strip invisible characters, and optionally mask email addresses or secret keys.

tools.name: privacyfold.code_minifier
tools.title: HTML / CSS / JS minifier & entity codec
tools.task: Minify HTML, CSS or JS and encode/decode HTML entities
tools.description: Minify CSS, HTML, or JavaScript snippets by stripping comments and collapsing whitespace, or encode/decode HTML entities (`&`, `<`, `>`).

tools.name: privacyfold.color_contrast
tools.title: Color palette & contrast checker
tools.task: Check WCAG contrast ratios & convert Hex/RGB
tools.description: Check WCAG 2.1 AA and AAA accessibility contrast ratios between foreground and background colors, and convert between Hex and RGB.

tools.name: privacyfold.cover_letter
tools.title: Cover letter generator
tools.task: Draft a tailored, metric-driven cover letter locally
tools.description: Generate a structured, concise cover letter tailored to a company and role without uploading your resume to third-party job portals.

tools.name: privacyfold.cron_parser
tools.title: Cron expression explainer
tools.task: Translate cron schedules into plain English
tools.description: Parse cron schedule expressions into a clear, human-readable description and preview the upcoming execution times.

tools.name: privacyfold.csv_json
tools.title: CSV ↔ JSON converter
tools.task: Convert between CSV tables and JSON arrays
tools.description: Convert CSV spreadsheets into structured JSON arrays, or convert JSON arrays back into CSV rows.

tools.name: privacyfold.eidas_sign
tools.title: eIDAS & local document signer
tools.task: Generate a local cryptographic signature & timestamp seal for documents
tools.description: Create a local electronic signature manifest with SHA-256 document digest, signer statement, and UTC timestamp in alignment with EU eIDAS (Regulation 910/2014) and US ESIGN Act principles.

tools.name: privacyfold.email_header
tools.title: Email header & SPF/DKIM/DMARC analyzer
tools.task: Inspect raw email headers for phishing hops, SPF, DKIM & DMARC authentication
tools.description: Paste raw email headers (`Received`, `Authentication-Results`, `Return-Path`) to trace server hops and verify SPF, DKIM, and DMARC status without uploading confidential emails to MXToolbox.

tools.name: privacyfold.exif_strip
tools.title: Photo metadata remover
tools.task: Remove hidden photo data
tools.description: Photos can carry hidden details such as where and when they were taken. Remove them before you share a picture.

tools.name: privacyfold.exposure_xray
tools.title: Exposure X-ray & redaction self-test
tools.task: See everything a file reveals before you share it
tools.description: Drop any photo, PDF, or text snippet to see what it gives away: GPS pins, camera serials, timestamps, author history, and hidden PDF text layers—plus a Redaction Self-Test proving 0 hidden words are recoverable.

tools.name: privacyfold.file_encrypt
tools.title: Password-protect text
tools.task: Lock a file with a password
tools.description: Encrypt any file with a passphrase, on your device.

tools.name: privacyfold.hash_gen
tools.title: Hash generator
tools.task: Get a file fingerprint (hash)
tools.description: Create a SHA fingerprint of text or any file, to check that it has not changed.

tools.name: privacyfold.heic_to_jpg
tools.title: Image format converter & resizer
tools.task: Convert an iPhone photo
tools.description: Open iPhone photos anywhere.

tools.name: privacyfold.image_compress
tools.title: Image compressor
tools.task: Make an image smaller
tools.description: Make photos and images smaller without uploading them. Choose a quality and size, and see the new file size before you download.

tools.name: privacyfold.image_to_pdf
tools.title: Image to PDF converter
tools.task: Combine JPG, PNG or WebP images into a clean PDF document
tools.description: Place one or more photos or scanned receipts onto a standard US Letter or A4 page with clean margins for instant printing or portal upload.

tools.name: privacyfold.image_upscaler
tools.title: AI image upscaler & restorer
tools.task: Upscale low-res photos 2× with edge sharpening
tools.description: Upscale small or compressed photos by 2× with edge-preserving super-resolution (Real-ESRGAN-compact / OmniSR-nano ~18 MB on WebGPU).

tools.name: privacyfold.invoice_generator
tools.title: Private invoice generator
tools.task: Create itemized client invoices with tax & discount calculations locally
tools.description: Generate itemized freelance or SMB invoices from `templates/invoice-us.json` with automatic line-item totals and tax calculation—zero cloud accounting accounts required.

tools.name: privacyfold.json_format
tools.title: JSON formatter
tools.task: Format JSON
tools.description: Check, tidy and minify JSON. The result updates as you type.

tools.name: privacyfold.jwt_decode
tools.title: JWT decoder
tools.task: Decode a JWT
tools.description: Read what is inside a JSON Web Token. The signature is not checked, so do not treat a decoded token as trusted.

tools.name: privacyfold.lease_generator
tools.title: Residential lease & rental agreement generator
tools.task: Generate a clean residential lease agreement locally with zero cloud storage
tools.description: Draft a residential lease or room rental agreement with landlord, tenant, premises address, monthly rent, security deposit, and notice period completely offline.

tools.name: privacyfold.lorem_ipsum
tools.title: Lorem Ipsum & placeholder text generator
tools.task: Generate paragraphs, sentences or UI copy placeholders
tools.description: Generate classic Latin Lorem Ipsum or privacy-themed design system placeholder paragraphs for wireframes and layouts.

tools.name: privacyfold.magic_eraser
tools.title: Object & watermark remover (Inpainting)
tools.task: Erase unwanted objects, dates or blemishes
tools.description: Remove unwanted objects, date stamps, or watermarks using fast-fourier convolution inpainting (LaMa-FP16-pruned ~38 MB on WebGPU) directly in your browser.

tools.name: privacyfold.markdown_prev
tools.title: Markdown to HTML converter
tools.task: Convert Markdown notes into clean HTML
tools.description: Convert Markdown headings, lists, code blocks, and links into clean, semantic HTML markup.

tools.name: privacyfold.meeting_notes
tools.title: Meeting notes formatter & focus timer
tools.task: Structure raw meeting notes into Decisions, Action Items & Owners
tools.description: Transform unstructured meeting scratchpads into a clean Markdown summary separating Key Decisions, Action Items (`[ ] Owner`), and Pomodoro focus blocks.

tools.name: privacyfold.nda_generator
tools.title: Mutual NDA & contract generator
tools.task: Generate a mutual or one-way Non-Disclosure Agreement locally
tools.description: Create a clean Mutual or Unilateral Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) from our local JSON template (`templates/nda-us.json`) without exposing party names to legal SaaS platforms.

tools.name: privacyfold.ocr_scan
tools.title: Fill from scan & local OCR
tools.task: Extract text & pre-fill W-9 / SA100 fields from a document scan
tools.description: Extract text from scanned IDs, invoices, or payslips locally in your browser and map fields to W-9 or SA100 boxes with human confirmation.

tools.name: privacyfold.passport_photo
tools.title: Passport & ID photo
tools.task: Make a passport photo
tools.description: Crop and resize a photo to official passport, visa and ID sizes. Pick a country, line your face up with the guide, then download a print-ready image.

tools.name: privacyfold.password_gen
tools.title: Password & passphrase generator
tools.task: Generate secure passwords or XKCD passphrases
tools.description: Generate high-entropy random passwords or memorable multi-word XKCD passphrases using your browser’s cryptographic random source.

tools.name: privacyfold.pdf_compress
tools.title: PDF compressor (Portal presets)
tools.task: Reduce PDF size for USCIS, UK Visa VFS, HMRC, or Email limits
tools.description: Compress PDF documents to meet strict government and email portal limits (USCIS I-130 <2 MB, UK Visa VFS <2 MB, HMRC SA100 <5 MB, Schengen VFS <5 MB, Court E-Filing <5 MB, Gmail <25 MB).

tools.name: privacyfold.pdf_flatten
tools.title: PDF flattener & form locker
tools.task: Flatten interactive form fields so they cannot be edited
tools.description: Flatten interactive AcroForm fields, checkboxes, and signature appearances into static page content for IRS 1099, USCIS, and notary submissions.

tools.name: privacyfold.pdf_merge
tools.title: Merge PDF
tools.task: Join PDF files
tools.description: Combine several PDFs into one, in the order you choose.

tools.name: privacyfold.pdf_metadata
tools.title: PDF metadata stripper
tools.task: Remove Author, Producer, Creator & revision history from PDFs
tools.description: Strip hidden /Author, /Creator, /Producer, /CreationDate, /ModDate, and XMP XML packets from PDF files before public release or legal filing.

tools.name: privacyfold.pdf_redact
tools.title: Document & image redactor
tools.task: Black out parts of a PDF
tools.description: Permanently remove sensitive text and areas.

tools.name: privacyfold.pdf_split
tools.title: Split PDF
tools.task: Split a PDF
tools.description: Pull page ranges out of a PDF into new files.

tools.name: privacyfold.pdf_to_image
tools.title: PDF page to image converter
tools.task: Render document pages to crisp PNG or JPEG images
tools.description: Rasterize document pages into high-resolution 300 DPI or 600 DPI PNG/JPEG images locally in your browser.

tools.name: privacyfold.pdf_to_word
tools.title: PDF to Word converter
tools.task: Convert PDF text & layout into an editable Word (.doc / RTF) file
tools.description: Convert PDF document pages and paragraphs into an editable Word-compatible document locally in your browser using pdf.js text extraction and RTF/DOCX structuring.

tools.name: privacyfold.pgp_crypto
tools.title: PGP / ECDSA armored message signer
tools.task: Sign & armor messages with WebCrypto ECDSA
tools.description: Sign cleartext messages using NIST P-256 / P-384 elliptic-curve keys in WebCrypto and output an ASCII-armored verification block.

tools.name: privacyfold.privacy_letter
tools.title: GDPR, CCPA & privacy policy generator
tools.task: Generate GDPR Art. 15/17 data requests, CCPA opt-outs & GDPR Art. 33 breach notices
tools.description: Generate legally structured GDPR Data Subject Access/Erasure Requests (EN/DE/FR), California CCPA Do-Not-Sell Opt-Out letters, Privacy Policies, or GDPR Art. 33 72-Hour Breach Notifications from `templates/gdpr-request-eu.json` and `ccpa-optout-ca.json`.

tools.name: privacyfold.qr_tool
tools.title: QR code generator & Wi-Fi card
tools.task: Create custom QR codes for URLs, Wi-Fi or vCards
tools.description: Generate high-contrast QR codes for website links, Wi-Fi logins, or vCards locally with zero tracking redirects.

tools.name: privacyfold.receipt_scanner
tools.title: Receipt & business card organizer
tools.task: Extract expense totals, dates & vendor contacts into a CSV/JSON ledger
tools.description: Parse pasted receipt lines or business card text into structured expense rows (Date, Vendor, Category, Amount, Tax) or vCard contacts locally.

tools.name: privacyfold.regex_tester
tools.title: Regex tester & explainer
tools.task: Test regular expressions against sample text
tools.description: Test regular expressions with live match counts, captured groups, and character positions.

tools.name: privacyfold.resume_builder
tools.title: ATS-optimized resume & CV builder
tools.task: Format an ATS-friendly single-column resume locally in your browser
tools.description: Build a clean, single-column ATS-compatible resume from `templates/resume-ats.json` that parses cleanly in Workday, Greenhouse, and Lever without storing your career history on resume websites.

tools.name: privacyfold.sa100_prep
tools.title: SA100 helper
tools.task: Prepare SA100 boxes
tools.description: Line up Self Assessment figures before you file.

tools.name: privacyfold.schema_validator

tools.task: Validate JSON-LD structured data or generate AI-crawler robots.txt rules
tools.description: Validate Schema.org JSON-LD (`SoftwareApplication`, `FAQPage`, `HowTo`, `Article`) for Google Search and AI citations, or generate a `robots.txt` file with explicit GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot rules.

tools.name: privacyfold.screenshot_annotate
tools.title: Screenshot annotator & callout marker
tools.task: Add numbered callout badges, highlight boxes & status banners to screenshots
tools.description: Add clean, high-contrast callout borders, step badges, and header captions to bug reports and documentation screenshots without uploading internal UI screens.

tools.name: privacyfold.signature_clean
tools.title: Signature cleaner
tools.task: Clean up a signature
tools.description: Lift a signature off paper onto a clear background.

tools.name: privacyfold.social_resizer
tools.title: Social media, e-commerce & app icon resizer
tools.task: Resize images to Amazon, Shopify, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube or Favicon specs
tools.description: One-click image resizer pre-loaded with official platform dimensions from `presets/social-media-sizes.json`, `ecommerce-sizes.json`, and `developer-icons.json` (Amazon 1000×1000, Shopify 2048×2048, LinkedIn 400×400 & 1584×396 Banner, Instagram 1080×1080, YouTube 1280×720, OG Image 1200×630, iOS/Android App Icon 512×512).

tools.name: privacyfold.spot_rejection
tools.title: Preset validator & compliance check
tools.task: Validate a file against official portal requirements (Lane B check)
tools.description: Verify whether an image or document looks consistent with published portal requirements (US State Dept, UK HMPO, EU Schengen, VFS Global) without modifying the file.

tools.name: privacyfold.sqlite_viewer

tools.task: Query CSV/JSON tables with SQL SELECT & WHERE

tools.name: privacyfold.stego_seal
tools.title: Watermark & document stamp

tools.name: privacyfold.text_diff

tools.task: Convert Unix epoch seconds/ms to ISO-8601, UTC & global timezones
tools.description: Convert Unix timestamps (seconds, milliseconds, or nanoseconds) to human-readable ISO-8601, RFC-2822, and major global timezones (US, UK, EU, India, Japan).

tools.name: privacyfold.ua_parser
tools.title: User-Agent & browser inspector
tools.task: Parse browser User-Agent strings into OS & engine
tools.description: Inspect any User-Agent string to identify the browser family, rendering engine, operating system, and device type.

tools.description: Convert between US Imperial and Metric units (inches ↔ mm/cm, lbs ↔ kg, °F ↔ °C, miles ↔ km, and print millimeters ↔ pixels at 300/600 DPI).

tools.name: privacyfold.url_codec
tools.title: URL encoder, decoder & parser
tools.task: Encode, decode or inspect URL parameters
tools.description: Decode or encode URL strings and break down query parameters, host, path, and protocol.

tools.name: privacyfold.w9_prep

tools.task: Fill a W-9
tools.description: Prepare the IRS W-9 from your details.
